title: WODin workout result
description: What the athlete actually did, produced by the page and read by an agent. Pairs with a plan (wod.schema.json) via workoutId.

duration.description: Total session time as mm:ss or h:mm:ss, from the page timer or typed by hand. Null if never started.

durationSec.description: Same value in seconds, so consumers need not parse.

rpe.description: The athlete's own answer. Null means they left it blank — never the plan's targetRpe, which is only ever shown as a ghost hint.

athleteSummary.description: Free text on how the session went. Null if left blank.

log.description: Every set that was not skipped, keyed "<exerciseId>.<setId>" — including sets done exactly as prescribed, which carry asPlanned: true. A set missing from here was either skipped or belongs to a skipped exercise; absence never means "done as planned". Sets only: movements inside rounds are logged under `sections`, never here.

notes.description: Athlete notes, keyed by exercise id — one per exercise, never per set. A block with a footer (a rounds section, or a format with a score) has one note for the whole block, keyed by the section id instead. Only non-empty notes appear.

exerciseRpe.description: How hard each movement felt, keyed by exercise id, 1–10. Separate from the session-level `rpe`: a workout can average out at 7 while one lift was a 9, and that difference is what tells you which movement to move next time. A block with a footer (a rounds section, or a format with a score) is rated once, keyed by the section id. Only what the athlete actually rated appears — an absent key means unrated, never easy.

skipped.description: Exercise ids the athlete marked Skip. Their sets are absent from log.

planHash.description: Optional digest of the plan this was logged against, so an agent can tell whether the plan changed underneath.

sections.description: Per-section results for sections that use formats, rounds, scaling options or modifiers, keyed by section id (the plan's, or sec1, sec2… assigned by position). Sections that use none of these are absent — `log` already describes them completely. This is the canonical home for score, optional, modifiers and rounds.

score.description: Convenience mirror: present only when exactly one section has a `sections` entry, copied from it. With two or more, read `sections`.

optional.description: Convenience mirror of the single `sections` entry's optional. Absent when more than one section has an entry.

modifiers.description: Convenience mirror of the single `sections` entry's modifiers. Absent when more than one section has an entry.

rounds.description: Convenience mirror of the single `sections` entry's rounds. Absent when more than one section has an entry.

score.description: The section's score, shaped by the plan's format.score. Null when the section is scored but the athlete left the box blank — distinct from an absent key, which means the section is not scored at all.

reps.description: Reps into the next, unfinished round. 0 when none.

optional.description: Scaling options the athlete switched on, as { id: true }. Only options that were on appear; an empty object means the section offered options and none were used.

modifiers.description: Every modifier the plan offered, true or false. All of them appear, because not wearing the vest is itself the answer.

rounds.description: One entry per round performed, in order, matching the plan's rounds expanded (reps and repeat applied). Round done is true exactly when every movement in it is done. Absent for amrap, whose rounds are unbounded — its score carries the count. Round movements are never written to `log`.

roundMovement.description: One movement in a logged round. Fields follow the movement's kind, as a log entry's do.

load.description: The absolute load actually used, in the plan's load unit.

loadBwMult.description: Copied from the plan, so the prescription travels with the actual load.

entry.description: One logged set. Which fields are present follows the exercise's kind.

load.description: Number in the plan's load unit. A string only when the athlete typed something non-numeric.

loadType.description: Present instead of load for unweighted work.

added.description: True for a set the athlete added beyond the prescription. Such sets are always asPlanned: false.

asPlanned.description: True when every logged value matches the prescription for this set. The cheap read on compliance — filter for false to see where the session diverged.
